messages:
sasha: Quick heads-up — planning a rebuild of the inference-runtime base image this Wed 09:00 PT. Goal: patch CVE-2026-1234, tighten seccomp, drop a few /sbin utils, and land immutable rootfs markers. Need RBAC checks for the signer and KMS rotation plan.

maria: +1. can you post a short preflight checklist? do we need to rotate cosign key for this one or can we reuse?

jonathan: we should rotate the cosign key if we change signing policy (we're adding COSE payload). rotation is low-friction if KMS supports key versioning — we can pin a previous key for rollback. audit logs: let's ensure key operations are logged to the org KMS audit sink for 90d.

ops-oncall: any blackout windows or traffic-sensitive routes we should avoid? inference-hosts have canary pool (50 pods) — recommend a rolling canary for 1 hour then ramp.

sasha: plan = 1) preflight sbom + vuln scan 2) build & sign in staging with existing KMS key 3) canary redeploy 50 pods 1h 4) rotate key & re-sign prod images 5) full rollout. If rotation step is risky we can skip and document.

maria: ok. who owns the KMS signer binding? need IAM change to allow CI pipeline to call sign operations. current binding is project:ci-service-account -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. we need roles/cloudkms.signer? (or cosign-integration role).

jonathan: KMS uses asymmetric keys for signing, the CI service account needs cloudkms.signBlob & cloudkms.getPublicKey. add a short-lived binding for the build job with TTL 1h via our iam-proxy. after sign complete revoke.

sasha: +1 to short-lived binding. also need registry write for cosign annotations — grant registry: artifact-writer scope to the same ephemeral token.

maria: preflight checklist (quick):
- SBOM generation (syft) + scan (grype)
- Ensure reproducible build flags set
- Run container-scan e2e smoke (not full prod)
- Upload staging image to reg-staging and sign
- Verify attestations in attest-store
- Confirm KMS audit sink exists and logs show signBlob events

maria: attaching commands for CI (local dev):
```bash
# generate sbom
syft packages:docker -o json -q -t sbom.json
# scan sbom
grype sbom:sbom.json --fail-on high
# sign image (cosign + KMS)
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key k8s://projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-key --output-signature sig.json gcr.io/redwood/inference-runtime:staging
```

ops-oncall: I'll reserve a 09:00-11:00 PT window and set a short alerting policy: if canary error-rate > 2% for 10m rollback automatically.

jonathan: logging/monitoring bites:
- Add a trace tag for "image-rebuild:4867770000" on deploys
- Ensure audit logs for KMS (signBlob) are forwarded to sec-observe (30d min)
- Push cosign verification results to the artifact index so console can show signed=true

sasha: RBAC question: we need a new role for "image-signer" allowing only signBlob+getPublicKey and limited to that key. maria can you draft the IAM policy? then infra can create it and we attach to ephemeral tokens.

maria: drafting now. minimal policy:
- resource: projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-key
- permissions: ["cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.getPublicKey","cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign"]
- condition: request.time < token.expiry (handled by iam-proxy)

maria: Q for infra: do we want to rotate the key immediately after signing staging or wait until prod sign? my leaning: sign staging with current key, test canary, then rotate key and sign prod (so prod index uses new key).

jonathan: that ordering reduces blast radius. but ensure the registry/attest-store indexes both keys so verification works for images signed by either. add key metadata (key id) to signature envelope.

ops-oncall: I'll add incident playbook snippet to the runbook: if canary fails, revert to previous image tag (keep last 3 tags), re-pin signer to previous public key in verifier config.

sasha: I'll own rollout orchestrations and PRs. maria: you own CI signing changes + IAM policy. jonathan: you own audit logship and verifier compatibility. ops-oncall: own schedule & rollback automation.

deploy-bot: [build-system] staging image build complete: gcr.io/redwood/inference-runtime:staging-4867770000 -> signed (cosign-key v3).

maria: verification pass local -> pushing canary now.

ops-oncall: canary started (50 pods). monitoring looking good at +8m. :thumbsup:

jonathan: saw signBlob entries in audit sink, forwarding to sec-observe. retention set to 90d for KMS logs.

sasha: can we add a post-rollout item to run a vuln delta compare against previous prod? want to catch regressions from pruning.

maria: will add that to the post-rollout checklist. run grype diff and check for new criticals.

sasha: thanks all. if anything unexpected ping #eng-oncall and tag me. I'll post final cutover notes after prod is green. :white_check_mark:
